name: Commit message
description: Writes a conventional commit message from a summary of the staged change.
content:
Write a git commit message for this change.

Change summary:
{{change_summary}}

Format:
- First line: type(scope): imperative summary, 72 characters or fewer. Use {{commit_type}} as the type, or pick the closest of feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, ci, chore.
- Blank line, then a body of short paragraphs explaining what changed and why. Wrap lines at 72 characters.
- Do not mention tools, assistants or model names.

Return only the commit message, in a single code block.

variables.name: change_summary
variables.description: What changed and why, in your own words
